categories.name: Package Management
categories.description_id: Instal dan kelola paket perangkat lunak

lessons.title: Update Package List
lessons.description: Update the list of available packages from Termux repositories.
lessons.description_id: Perbarui daftar paket yang tersedia dari repositori Termux.
tips: Run this before installing any new package
Use 'pkg upgrade' to actually install updates
tips_id: Jalankan ini sebelum menginstal paket baru

quiz.question: What does 'pkg update' do?
options: Updates the package list from repositories

lessons.title: Upgrade Packages
lessons.description: Upgrade installed packages to their latest versions.
lessons.description_id: Tingkatkan paket yang terinstal ke versi terbaru.
output: 0 upgraded, 0 newly installed, 0 to remove and 0 not upgraded.
tips: This may take time depending on your connection
tips_id: Ini mungkin memerlukan waktu tergantung koneksi

quiz.question: What's the difference between 'pkg update' and 'pkg upgrade'?
options: No difference, they are the same
Update refreshes the list, Upgrade installs updates
Update removes packages, Upgrade adds them
Update is for system, Upgrade is for apps
options_id: Update menyegarkan daftar, Upgrade menginstal pembaruan
Update untuk sistem, Upgrade untuk aplikasi

lessons.title: Alternative Update (apt)
lessons.description: Alternative command to update package lists using apt.
lessons.description_id: Perintah alternatif untuk memperbarui daftar paket menggunakan apt.
tips: 'pkg' is a wrapper that makes apt easier to use
tips_id: 'pkg' adalah wrapper yang memudahkan penggunaan apt

quiz.question: Which is the underlying package manager in Termux?
quiz.question_id: Mana package manager dasar di Termux?

lessons.title: Alternative Upgrade (apt)
lessons.description: Alternative command to upgrade installed package software.
lessons.description_id: Perintah alternatif untuk meningkatkan software paket yang terinstal.
tips_id: Sama dengan 'pkg upgrade' tapi level lebih rendah

lessons.title: List Directory Contents
lessons.description: List files and directories in the current folder.
lessons.description_id: Tampilkan daftar file dan folder yang ada di direktori saat ini.
tips_id: Gunakan 'ls -lh' untuk ukuran yang mudah dibaca

quiz.question: What does 'ls -la' show that 'ls' doesn't?
quiz.question_id: Apa yang ditampilkan 'ls -la' yang tidak ditampilkan 'ls'?

lessons.title: Change Directory
lessons.description: Change the current working directory to navigate directories.
lessons.description_id: Pindah direktori aktif untuk menjelajahi folder.
tips: Use 'cd ..' to go up one level
Use 'cd ~' to go to home directory
Use 'cd -' to go to previous directory

quiz.question: How do you go to the parent directory?

lessons.title: Print Working Directory
lessons.description: Print working directory path showing where you currently are.
lessons.description_id: Tampilkan jalur direktori lengkap tempat Anda berada saat ini.
tips: Useful when you're deep in nested directories
The output shows the absolute path
tips_id: Berguna saat Anda berada di direktori bersarang

lessons.title: Make Directory
lessons.description: Create a new folder or directory with a specified name.
lessons.description_id: Buat folder atau direktori baru dengan nama yang ditentukan.
tips: Use 'mkdir -p path/to/dir' to create nested directories
tips_id: Gunakan 'mkdir -p path/to/dir' untuk membuat direktori bersarang

lessons.title: Remove Empty Directory
lessons.description: Remove or delete an empty directory.
lessons.description_id: Hapus direktori atau folder kosong.

lessons.title: Remove Files/Directories
lessons.description: Remove or delete files or directories permanently.
lessons.description_id: Hapus file atau direktori secara permanen.
tips: WARNING: This is PERMANENT - no recycle bin!
Use 'rm -i' for interactive mode (asks before deleting)
Use 'rm -r' for recursive deletion of directories
tips_id: PERINGATAN: Ini PERMANEN - tidak ada tempat sampah!

quiz.question: Which flag makes rm ask before deleting?
quiz.question_id: Flag mana yang membuat rm bertanya sebelum menghapus?

lessons.title: Copy Files/Folders
lessons.description: Copy files or folders from one location to another.
lessons.description_id: Salin file atau folder dari satu lokasi ke lokasi lain.
tips: Use 'cp -r' for recursive copy of directories

lessons.title: Move/Rename Files
lessons.description: Move files or folders, also used to rename files/folders.
lessons.description_id: Pindahkan file/folder, atau gunakan untuk mengubah nama file/folder.
tips: Same as cut-paste in GUI file managers
tips_id: Sama seperti cut-paste di file manager GUI

lessons.title: Create Empty File
lessons.description: Create a new empty file or update the access/modification date.
lessons.description_id: Buat file kosong baru atau perbarui tanggal modifikasi file.
tips: If file exists, updates its timestamp
Can create multiple files: touch a.txt b.txt c.txt
tips_id: Bisa membuat banyak file: touch a.txt b.txt c.txt

lessons.title: Display File Contents
lessons.description: Concatenate and display the contents of a file in the terminal.
lessons.description_id: Tampilkan seluruh isi file teks langsung ke layar terminal.
output: Welcome to Termux Tutorial by Tim Iminthisera!
Enjoy learning coding on your smartphone.
tips: Use 'cat > file.txt' to create and write to a file
Use 'cat file1 file2 > combined.txt' to merge files
tips_id: Gunakan 'cat > file.txt' untuk membuat dan menulis ke file
Gunakan 'cat file1 file2 > combined.txt' untuk menggabungkan file

lessons.title: Clear Terminal Screen
lessons.description: Clear all text from the terminal screen to start fresh.
lessons.description_id: Bersihkan semua tampilan teks di layar terminal agar rapi kembali.

lessons.title: Setup Phone Storage Access
lessons.description: Request Android permission for Termux to access shared phone storage.
lessons.description_id: Minta izin Android agar Termux dapat mengakses penyimpanan internal HP.
tips: Run this FIRST before working with phone files
tips_id: Jalankan ini PERTAMA sebelum bekerja dengan file HP

quiz.question: What does termux-setup-storage create?
options: Symlinks in ~/storage pointing to phone storage
options_id: Symlink di ~/storage yang menunjuk ke penyimpanan HP

lessons.title: Install Git
lessons.description: Install Git to clone repositories and manage version control.
lessons.description_id: Instal Git untuk menyalin repositori kode dan mengelola versi kode.
tips: Essential for downloading code from GitHub
After install, configure: git config --global user.name 'Your Name'
tips_id: Penting untuk mengunduh kode dari GitHub
Setelah instal, konfigurasi: git config --global user.name 'Nama Anda'

lessons.title: Install Python
lessons.description: Install the Python programming language environment.
lessons.description_id: Instal bahasa pemrograman Python untuk menjalankan skrip python.
tips: Includes pip for installing Python packages
tips_id: Termasuk pip untuk menginstal paket Python

lessons.title: Install Nano Editor
lessons.description: Install Nano, a lightweight and easy-to-use terminal text editor.
lessons.description_id: Instal Nano, editor teks terminal yang ringan dan mudah digunakan.

lessons.title: Install Curl
lessons.description: Install Curl to send requests and download content from URLs.
lessons.description_id: Instal Curl untuk berkirim data atau mengunduh konten dari URL web.

lessons.title: Install Wget
lessons.description: Install Wget to download files from HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP servers.
lessons.description_id: Instal Wget untuk mengunduh file dari internet via tautan/link.

lessons.title: Install Clang Compiler
lessons.description: Install Clang C/C++ compiler and toolchain for coding.
lessons.description_id: Instal compiler Clang C/C++ untuk mengompilasi kode program C/C++.

lessons.title: Install Node.js
lessons.description: Install Node.js JavaScript runtime environment.
lessons.description_id: Instal Node.js untuk mengeksekusi kode program JavaScript di terminal.

lessons.title: Show Current User
lessons.description: Display the active username of the current Termux shell.
lessons.description_id: Tampilkan nama user aktif pada sesi shell Termux saat ini.
tips: In Termux, you're not root by default
Shows your Android app user ID
tips_id: Di Termux, Anda bukan root secara default
Menunjukkan ID user aplikasi Android Anda

lessons.title: System Information
lessons.description: Print detailed operating system, device architecture, and kernel info.
lessons.description_id: Tampilkan detail info sistem operasi, arsitektur HP, dan kernel.
output: Linux localhost 4.19.113-android-g92a #1 SMP PREEMPT Sun Jun 14 aarch64 Android
